# A Jew - Breslov Torah Library

> The largest free online Breslov Torah library with 226+ sacred Jewish texts and 25,000+ pages in Hebrew and English, featuring Likutay Moharan, Zohar, Talmud, Tanach, and Rambam.

## Core Library

- [Torah Library Reader](https://ajew.org/reader): Full bilingual reader with 226+ books, 25,000+ pages including Breslov, Talmud, Tanach, Zohar, and Rambam texts with bookmarks and reading history.
- [Likutay Moharan](https://ajew.org/teachings/likutay-moharan): Rabbi Nachman of Breslov's primary Torah teaching collection with 411 teachings in two volumes, Hebrew text with English translation.
- [About ajew.org](https://ajew.org/about): Overview of the library's mission, content, features, and the teachings of Rebbe Nachman of Breslov (1772-1810).

## Study Tools

- [Daily Study](https://ajew.org/daily-study): Structured daily learning schedule cycling through Likutay Moharan, Tehillim, and Likutay Tefilos.
- [Torah GPS](https://ajew.org/torah-gps): Interactive tool for exploring connections between Torah concepts and teachings.
- [Chain of Light](https://ajew.org/chain-of-light): Visual exploration of the chain of Torah transmission and Breslov lineage.
- [Search](https://ajew.org/search): Full-text search across 22,000+ indexed documents with support for Hebrew, English, gematria, and acronym search modes.
- [Torah Trivia](https://ajew.org/trivia): Interactive quiz game on Breslov teachings, Torah topics, and Jewish knowledge at four difficulty levels.
- [Gematria Calculator](https://ajew.org/gematria): Hebrew gematria calculator for exploring numerical Torah connections.
- [Healing Words](https://ajew.org/healing-words): Curated collection of Rebbe Nachman's teachings on healing, comfort, and spiritual medicine.

## Teachings

- [Likutay Halachos](https://ajew.org/teachings/likutay-halachos): Rabbi Natan's magnum opus applying Rebbe Nachman's teachings to Jewish law.
- [Sipurey Maasiyos](https://ajew.org/teachings/stories): The 13 mystical tales of Rebbe Nachman of Breslov.
- [Shivchay HaRan](https://ajew.org/teachings/shivchay): Praises and accounts of Rebbe Nachman's greatness.
- [Sefer HaMiddos](https://ajew.org/teachings/midos): The Book of Traits - alphabetical guide to character refinement.
- [Advice (Likutay Eitzos)](https://ajew.org/teachings/advice): Practical spiritual advice distilled from Likutay Moharan.
- [Na Nach Teachings](https://ajew.org/teachings/naanaach-index): Teachings and traditions of the Na Nach movement.
- [Blossoms of the Spring](https://ajew.org/teachings/blossoms-of-the-stream): Letters of Rebbe Nachman of Breslov.

## Reference

- [Torah Topics](https://ajew.org/topics): Teachings organized by subject from prayer and joy to faith and livelihood.
- [Weekly Parsha](https://ajew.org/parsha): Torah portion commentary and Breslov insights for each week's reading.
- [Reference Lookup](https://ajew.org/reference): Cross-reference tool for finding Torah source connections.
- [Library Index](https://ajew.org/library): Complete catalog of all 226+ texts organized by category and author.

## Key Facts

- Largest free online Breslov Torah library
- 226+ sacred Jewish texts, 25,000+ pages
- Bilingual: Hebrew original texts with English translations
- Primary collection: Likutay Moharan by Rabbi Nachman of Breslov (1772-1810), 411 teachings
- Also includes: Talmud Bavli (39 tractates), Tanach (39 books), Zohar (8 volumes), Rambam Mishneh Torah (14 books), 40+ Breslov classics
- Free and open access, no registration required for reading
- Built on the Na Nach movement's mission of accessible Torah education
